document.abstract: Sound-recording operations of the Signal Corps Photographic Center are concerned principally with the production of army training films and special service films. Sound is used in training films very much the same as in commercial teaching films. Depending upon the type of subject and its treatment, some pictures are photographed silent, then scored with narration and essential effects; others are taken in live sound and augmented with effects and library music in the re-recording process.
